name: FFS_CML_MAP_LAYER
description: Stores URLs for custom map layers.

columns.name: LAYER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for Custom Map Layer.

columns.name: LAYER_LABEL
columns.description: User defined human readable layer identifier.

columns.name: LAYER_TYPE
columns.description: Type of layer (enum: 'internal', 'external').

columns.name: LAYER_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Data source name for external layer.

columns.name: LAYER_THEME
columns.description: MapViewer theme for external layer.

columns.name: LAYER_URL
columns.description: URL to MapViewer for external layer.

columns.name: LAYER_STATUS
columns.description: Status of layer (enum: 'active','inactive').

columns.name: LAYER_JOB_ID
columns.description: Identifier To Track Layer Proccessing Status.

columns.name: LAYER_CREATED
columns.description: Date and time when was layer created.

columns.name: LAYER_UPDATED
columns.description: Layer last update date and time.

columns.name: LAYER_SOURCE_URL
columns.description: Source URL for internal layer shapefile.

columns.name: LAYER_SRID
columns.description: Spatial reference identifier(SRID) of layer.

columns.name: LAYER_ASSIGNMENT
columns.description: Layer assigment (enum: 'work_zone ','layer').

columns.name: LAYER_SHAPE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Shape identifier column name for work_zone layer.

columns.name: ACTION_LINK_ID
columns.description: Reference to Action Link if the hint button is set.

columns.name: FORM_ID
columns.description: Reference to Form if the hint button is set.

columns.name: PLUGIN_FORM_FIELD_LOB
columns.description: Data in JSON format related with Plugin/Form proprties if the hint button is set.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
